edits.current:
Separately, [reviewed scalar Fin](../evidence/reviewed-scalar-hosts-20261007/receipt.json) runs on Python 3.11 and 3.12, and [reviewed container Fin](../evidence/reviewed-fin-hosts-20261007/receipt.json) runs through installed Python packages. Both local reviewed reports measure source and adapter rejection inside the installed Python process.

The newer [Python/Rust container CI receipt](../evidence/python-rust-container-dispatch-20261009/receipt.json) records 2,029 Python checks per source route, with author sources removed before offline installation and reproducible wheels retaining the `manylinux_2_38_x86_64` floor. Both ordinary-source and reviewed-IR packages measure `mirrorAll` and `orDefault` inside the installed Python process. Invalid public calls enter neither the adapter nor the Lean function; raw invalid calls enter the adapter but not the function. Valid calls enter both. These counters do not measure products, fields, callbacks or `Subtype`. The [original artifact membership](../evidence/python-rust-container-dispatch-20261009/artifact-membership.json) binds each report to its retained CI ZIP. The Python job succeeded; the parent workflow was cancelled. These reports do not claim a full installed-tree move.

The newer [Python/Rust container CI receipt](../evidence/python-rust-container-dispatch-20261009/receipt.json) records 2,027 Rust checks per source route. Both ordinary-source and reviewed-IR packages measure `mirrorAll` and `orDefault` inside the installed Rust process. Invalid public calls enter neither the adapter nor the Lean function; raw invalid calls enter the adapter but not the function. Valid calls enter both. These counters do not measure products, fields, callbacks or `Subtype`. Two author roots reproduce the crate before source removal and offline installation; Cargo still compiles the consumer without Lean or producer tools. The [original artifact membership](../evidence/python-rust-container-dispatch-20261009/artifact-membership.json) binds each report to its retained CI ZIP. The Rust job succeeded; the parent workflow was cancelled. These reports do not claim a full installed-tree move.

[Hosted Python/Rust container checks](../evidence/python-rust-container-dispatch-20261009/receipt.json) count `mirrorAll` and `orDefault` source and adapter entries in each installed host process, for ordinary-source and reviewed-IR packages. Invalid public calls enter neither; raw invalid calls enter only the adapter; valid calls enter both. The counters cover these two exports, not products, fields, callbacks or `Subtype`. Both selected jobs succeeded, with source-free offline installation and two-root reproducibility; the parent workflow was cancelled. Python retains its glibc 2.38 wheel floor. The [retained CI artifacts](../evidence/python-rust-container-dispatch-20261009/artifact-membership.json) authenticate the reports. These checks do not claim a full installed-tree move.
